title: AnarhyStones
description: A high-performance, block-based region protection plugin. Let players claim land instantly using custom blocks with full WorldGuard integration!
body:
# 💎 AnarhyStones
AnarhyStones is a high-performance, block-based region protection plugin for Minecraft servers. Built on top of WorldGuard, it allows players to claim land simply by placing a specific block. Perfect for Survival, Factions, and Anarchy servers!

# 🔗 Links
Source Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/TheJumer/AnarhyStones)
Report Bugs: [Discord](https://discord.gg/PWHhcUHDD4)

# 🚀 Key Features
Custom Protection Blocks: Create unlimited types of blocks via .toml files.

WorldGuard Integration: Automatically applies flags like pvp deny or tnt deny.

Dynamic Limits: Set region limits per player/rank (e.g., via LuckPerms).

Teleportation System: Built-in /as home with configurable warm-up delays.

Holograms: Elegant armor-stand displays showing owner and radius.

Anti-Grief Physics: Protection blocks cannot be moved by pistons or destroyed by TNT.

Multilingual: Supports English, Ukrainian, and Russian out of the box.

# 📋 Commands & Permissions
- /as get  — Get a protection block (anarhystones.admin)
- 
- /as toggle — Enable/disable region placement (anarhystones.place)
- 
- /as info — View detailed region information
- 
- /as home — Teleport to your region's home
- 
- /as sethome — Set a new home location for the region
- 
- /as add  — Add a member to your region
- 
- /as remove  — Remove a member from your region
- 
- /as addowner  — Add a co-owner to your region
- 
- /as removeowner  — Remove a co-owner from your region
- 
- /as count — List all your regions and coordinates
- 
- /as reload — Reload configuration and languages (anarhystones.admin)
- 
- /as debug — Toggle personal debug mode (anarhystones.admin)
- To set limits, use: anarhystones.limit.<number>

# 🛠 Installation & Setup
Download the latest .jar file and place it in your plugins folder.

Ensure you have WorldGuard and WorldEdit installed.

Restart your server to generate the default configuration.

Edit files in /plugins/AnarhyStones/blocks/ to create your own unique stones!
